        गहरे विषय-विशेषज्ञता के कारण प्रभावित करता है, तो वे:
options_hindi: जबरदस्ती शक्ति

questions.question_english: If a principal influences staff because of their extensive knowledge of pedagogical theories and deep subject-matter expertise, they are utilizing:
options_english: Coercive Power
Legitimate Power
Expert Power
Reward Power
questions.explanation_english: Expert power is derived from an individual’s specialized knowledge, technical competence, and pedagogical expertise. When a principal influences faculty members because of deep subject-matter knowledge, curriculum expertise, and proven instructional skills, teachers respect and adopt the leader’s guidance based on recognized professional competence rather than formal coercion.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। विशेषज्ञ शक्ति एक व्यक्ति के विशेष ज्ञान, तकनीकी क्षमता और शैक्षिक विशेषज्ञता से उत्पन्न होती है। जब एक प्रधान शिक्षकों को गहरे विषय ज्ञान, पाठ्यक्रम विशेषज्ञता और सिद्ध शिक्षण कौशल के कारण प्रभावित करता है, तो शिक्षक मान्यता प्राप्त पेशेवर क्षमता के आधार पर नेता के मार्गदर्शन का सम्मान करते हैं और अपनाते हैं, न कि औपचारिक दबाव के आधार पर।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Expert Power
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Expert power is derived from an individual’s specialized knowledge, technical competence, and pedagogical expertise.

एक औपचारिक पांच वर्षीय अवधि में वित्तीय बजट पूर्वानुमान और पूंजी योजना

questions.question_english: The term 'Micro-planning' in education refers to:
options_english: Macro-level educational planning conducted at the central national level by the Ministry of Education
State-level policy planning and administrative management executed directly by the Directorate
Grassroots planning at the local level involving community stakeholders
Financial budget forecasting and capital planning projected across a formal five-year term period
questions.explanation_english: Micro-planning in educational administration represents a localized, decentralized planning process operating at the village, institutional, or community level. It directly involves local community members, parents, and school heads in identifying specific educational needs, mobilizing local resources, increasing enrollment, and designing contextualized developmental interventions tailored to the immediate local environment. The other options describe broader planning processes that do not capture the essence of micro-planning.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। शिक्षा में सूक्ष्म-योजना शैक्षिक प्रशासन में एक स्थानीयकृत, विकेंद्रीकृत योजना प्रक्रिया को दर्शाती है जो गांव, संस्थान या सामुदायिक स्तर पर कार्य करती है। यह स्थानीय समुदाय के सदस्यों, माता-पिता और स्कूल प्रमुखों को विशिष्ट शैक्षिक आवश्यकताओं की पहचान करने, स्थानीय संसाधनों को जुटाने, नामांकन बढ़ाने और तत्काल स्थानीय वातावरण के लिए अनुकूलित विकासात्मक हस्तक्षेपों को डिजाइन करने में सीधे शामिल करती है। अन्य विकल्प व्यापक योजना प्रक्रियाओं का वर्णन करते हैं जो सूक्ष्म-योजना के सार को नहीं पकड़ते।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Grassroots planning at the local level involving community stakeholders

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Micro-planning in educational administration represents a localized, decentralized planning process operating at the village, institutional, or community level.

questions.question_english: A supervisor who heavily emphasizes the technical aspects of the lesson (e.g., use of TLM, board work) while neglecting the emotional and social climate of the classroom is applying:
options_english: A holistic and humanistic supervisory approach
A narrow, mechanistic supervisory approach
A clinical, democratic supervisory approach
A vision-driven transformational approach
questions.explanation_english: A supervisor focusing strictly on technical parameters while neglecting classroom social dynamics and emotional climate employs a narrow, mechanistic supervisory approach. This traditional perspective treats instructional delivery like an industrial assembly line, ignoring the humanistic, relational, and psychological factors essential for creating an engaging and supportive learning environment.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। एक पर्यवेक्षक जो केवल तकनीकी पहलुओं पर ध्यान केंद्रित करता है और कक्षा के सामाजिक और भावनात्मक वातावरण की अनदेखी करता है, वह संकीर्ण, यांत्रिक पर्यवेक्षण दृष्टिकोण का उपयोग कर रहा है। यह दृष्टिकोण शिक्षण प्रक्रिया को औद्योगिक असेंबली लाइन की तरह मानता है, जो मानवता, संबंध और मनोवैज्ञानिक कारकों की अनदेखी करता है जो एक आकर्षक और सहायक शिक्षण वातावरण बनाने के लिए आवश्यक हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) A narrow, mechanistic supervisory approach

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: A supervisor focusing strictly on technical parameters while neglecting classroom social dynamics and emotional climate employs a narrow, mechanistic supervisory approach.

दूसरे व्यक्ति के सक्रिय रूप से बोलने के दौरान व्यक्तिगत प्रतिवाद या उत्तर तैयार करना

questions.question_english: According to the principles of Effective Communication, 'Active Listening' by a Principal during a conflict resolution meeting requires:
options_english: Interrupting speakers frequently throughout the meeting in order to firmly assert official authority
Formulating a personal rebuttal or reply while the other individual is actively still speaking
Paying full attention, withholding judgment, and reflecting back messages to confirm understanding
Multitasking by reviewing and signing administrative documents while the teacher actively speaks
questions.explanation_english: Active listening during interpersonal communication requires paying complete attention to the speaker, suspending immediate judgment, observing non-verbal cues, and paraphrasing messages back to confirm mutual understanding. In conflict management, school leaders using active listening de-escalate emotional tensions, demonstrate genuine respect, and clarify underlying concerns effectively before making administrative decisions.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। सक्रिय सुनना अंतरव्यक्तिगत संचार के दौरान वक्ता पर पूर्ण ध्यान देने, तात्कालिक निर्णय को निलंबित करने, गैर-मौखिक संकेतों का अवलोकन करने, और आपसी समझ की पुष्टि के लिए संदेशों को फिर से व्यक्त करने की आवश्यकता होती है। संघर्ष प्रबंधन में, सक्रिय सुनने का उपयोग करने वाले स्कूल नेता भावनात्मक तनाव को कम करते हैं, वास्तविक सम्मान प्रदर्शित करते हैं, और प्रशासनिक निर्णय लेने से पहले अंतर्निहित चिंताओं को प्रभावी ढंग से स्पष्ट करते हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Paying full attention, withholding judgment, and reflecting back messages to confirm understanding
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Active listening during interpersonal communication requires paying complete attention to the speaker.

It shows the overall educational program, institutional priorities, and curricular balance
It directly indicates the overall financial health, fiscal allocation, and budgetary strength of the school

questions.explanation_english: Describing a timetable as a mirror of the school signifies that it reflects the institution’s complete educational philosophy, structural priorities, and pedagogical approach. questions.question_english: In educational decision-making, the “Bounded Rationality” model suggests that administrators:
options_english: Make completely irrational decisions based on emotions
Have access to all possible information before making a decision
Make decisions that are “good enough” or satisficing due to cognitive and informational limitations
Seek optimal solutions by exhausting every possible alternative
questions.explanation_english: Herbert Simon introduced the bounded rationality model to explain decision-making in complex administrative environments. The theory asserts that educational administrators operate under finite time, limited information, and cognitive constraints. Consequently, leaders cannot evaluate every possible alternative to find an absolute optimal solution; instead, they select satisfactory or acceptable solutions that meet basic organizational criteria.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। हर्बर्ट साइमोन ने सीमित तर्कशीलता मॉडल को जटिल प्रशासनिक वातावरण में निर्णय-निर्माण को समझाने के लिए पेश किया। यह सिद्धांत बताता है कि शैक्षिक प्रशासक सीमित समय, सीमित जानकारी और संज्ञानात्मक सीमाओं के तहत कार्य करते हैं। इसलिए, नेता हर संभव विकल्प का मूल्यांकन नहीं कर सकते हैं ताकि एक पूर्णतम समाधान मिल सके; इसके बजाय, वे संतोषजनक या स्वीकार्य समाधान चुनते हैं जो बुनियादी संगठनात्मक मानदंडों को पूरा करते हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Make decisions that are “good enough” or
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Herbert Simon introduced the bounded rationality model to explain decision-making in complex administrative environments.

questions.question_english:
According to the Right of Children to Free and
    Compulsory Education (RTE) Act, 2009, what is the minimum percentage of parents or guardians that must be included in the School Management Committee (SMC)?
questions.explanation_english: Under Section 21 of the Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Act, 2009, it is mandated that every non-minority government and aided school must form a School Management Committee. The law specifies that at least 75 percent of the committee's total membership must consist of parents or guardians of enrolled students, ensuring their active participation in school governance.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। बालकों के लिए मुफ्त और अनिवार्य शिक्षा अधिनियम, 2009 के अनुसार, हर गैर-न्यूनतम सरकारी और सहायता प्राप्त स्कूल को एक स्कूल प्रबंधन समिति का गठन करना आवश्यक है। इस अधिनियम में यह अनिवार्य किया गया है कि समिति की कुल सदस्यता का कम से कम 75 प्रतिशत हिस्सा उन माता-पिता या अभिभावकों का होना चाहिए जो छात्रों के नामांकित हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) 75%

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The statute mandates that at least 75 percent of the committee’s total membership must consist of parents or guardians of enrolled students.

questions.question_english: A primary objective of the School Development Plan (SDP) mandated by the RTE Act is to:
options_english: Ensure that the educational institution operates efficiently to generate substantial financial profit
Estimate teacher, infrastructure, and financial resource needs for a three-year period
Document and detail the specific daily instructional lesson plans prepared by every classroom teacher
Plan and schedule expensive international study excursions and exchange trips for enrolled students
questions.explanation_english: Under the Right to Education Act, the primary objective of the School Development Plan is to provide a comprehensive three-year strategic framework. The plan systematically estimates required institutional resources, including teacher staffing numbers, physical infrastructure enhancements, instructional materials, and financial allocations needed to meet mandatory statutory quality standards.

questions.question_english: Community participation in education emphasizes that:
options_english: Education is the exclusive structural domain of certified professional educators and government bureaucrats
The community is an active stakeholder and partner in education and school development

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Community participation in education reflects the principle that schools and local communities are interdependent partners.

questions.question_english: In conflict management, the 'Collaborating' style (based on the Thomas-Kilmann model) is characterized by:
options_english: High assertiveness and high cooperativeness, seeking a win-win solution
Low assertiveness and low cooperativeness, avoiding the issue entirely
High assertiveness and low cooperativeness, forcing one’s own will on others

questions.explanation_english: In the Thomas-Kilmann Conflict Mode Instrument, the collaborating style represents a high-assertiveness and high-cooperativeness approach. Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: In the Thomas-Kilmann Conflict Mode Instrument, the collaborating style represents a high-assertiveness and high-cooperativeness approach.

questions.question_english:
The 'Johari Window' is a conceptual model
     utilized in organizational leadership primarily to
     enhance:
options_english: Technical school timetable construction efficiency and period allocation
Interpersonal communication, self-awareness, and mutual understanding among staff
Financial accounting, record management, and statutory auditing transparency
Architectural design, physical ventilation, and artificial lighting of classrooms
questions.explanation_english: The Johari Window is a cognitive communication model designed to enhance interpersonal awareness, personal self-reflection, and group dynamics within organizations. By categorizing personal information into four distinct quadrants based on self-knowledge and peer feedback, the tool assists team members in expanding open communication channels, building trust, and reducing interpersonal blind spots.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। जोहरी विंडो एक संज्ञानात्मक संचार मॉडल है जो संगठनों के भीतर अंतरव्यक्तिगत जागरूकता, व्यक्तिगत आत्म-प्रतिबिंब, और समूह गतिशीलता को बढ़ाने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है। यह व्यक्तिगत जानकारी को आत्म-ज्ञान और सहकर्मी फीडबैक के आधार पर चार अलग-अलग चौकोरों में वर्गीकृत करता है, जिससे टीम के सदस्यों को खुली संचार चैनलों का विस्तार करने, विश्वास बनाने, और अंतरव्यक्तिगत अंधे स्थानों को कम करने में मदद मिलती है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Interpersonal communication, self-awareness, and mutual understanding among staff

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The Johari Window is a cognitive communication model designed to enhance interpersonal awareness, personal self-reflection, and group dynamics within organizations.

questions.question_hindi: जब एक प्रधानाचार्य सभी शिक्षण स्टाफ को नए परीक्षा दिशानिर्देशों का विवरण देने वाला एक परिपत्र भेजता है, तो यह किस संचार दिशा का मुख्य रूप से उपयोग किया जाता है?
options_hindi: ऊर्ध्व संचार
अवधि संचार
आड़ा/क्षैतिज संचार
तिरछा संचार

questions.subject: Management
questions.question_english: What communication direction is primarily utilized when a Principal sends a circular detailing the new examination guidelines to all teaching staff?
options_english: Upward communication
Downward communication
Lateral/Horizontal communication
Diagonal communication
questions.explanation_english: Downward communication occurs when messages flow from higher administrative authority levels to subordinate employees along the formal organizational hierarchy. When a principal issues official circulars, policies, examination guidelines, or operational directives to teaching staff, it represents downward communication aimed at directing actions, providing instructions, and maintaining institutional order.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। यह संचार की वह दिशा है जिसमें संदेश उच्च प्रशासनिक स्तरों से अधीनस्थ कर्मचारियों तक प्रवाहित होते हैं। जब प्रधानाचार्य आधिकारिक परिपत्र, नीतियाँ, परीक्षा दिशानिर्देश या संचालन निर्देश शिक्षण स्टाफ को जारी करते हैं, तो यह अवधि संचार का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है जो क्रियाओं को निर्देशित करने, निर्देश प्रदान करने और संस्थागत व्यवस्था बनाए रखने के लिए होता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Downward communication

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Downward communication occurs when messages flow from higher administrative authority levels to subordinate employees along the formal organizational hierarchy.

questions.question_hindi:
नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं: एक को असर्शन (A) और दूसरे को कारण (R) के रूप में लेबल किया गया है। 
असर्शन (A): प्रधान को प्रशासनिक प्रबंधक और शैक्षणिक नेता की दोहरी भूमिकाओं को संतुलित करना चाहिए। 
कारण (R): जबकि प्रशासनिक प्रबंधन विद्यालय के सुचारू संचालन को सुनिश्चित करता है, शैक्षणिक नेतृत्व सीधे शिक्षण और सीखने में सुधार के मुख्य उद्देश्य को प्रभावित करता है।
options_hindi: दोनों A और R सत्य हैं और R A का सही स्पष्टीकरण है
दोनों A और R सत्य हैं लेकिन R A का सही स्पष्टीकरण नहीं है
A सत्य है लेकिन R गलत है
A गलत है लेकिन R सत्य है

questions.subject: Management
questions.question_english:
The following are two statements: one is labeled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R). 
Assertion (A): The Principal must balance the dual roles of an administrative manager and an instructional leader. 
Reason (R): While administrative management ensures the smooth operational functioning of the school, instructional leadership directly impacts the core objective of improving teaching and learning.
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english: School heads must effectively balance administrative management and instructional leadership. While administrative duties ensure smooth operational functioning, resource budgeting, and facility maintenance, instructional leadership directly focuses on curriculum enhancement, classroom observation, and teacher development. Combining both roles creates an organized, structured environment that optimizes student learning and growth.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। विद्यालय के प्रमुखों को प्रशासनिक प्रबंधन और शैक्षणिक नेतृत्व को प्रभावी ढंग से संतुलित करना चाहिए। जबकि प्रशासनिक कार्य सुचारू संचालन, संसाधन बजट, और सुविधाओं के रखरखाव को सुनिश्चित करते हैं, शैक्षणिक नेतृत्व सीधे पाठ्यक्रम सुधार, कक्षा अवलोकन, और शिक्षक विकास पर केंद्रित होता है। दोनों भूमिकाओं का संयोजन एक संगठित, संरचित वातावरण बनाता है जो छात्र सीखने और विकास को अनुकूलित करता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: School heads must effectively balance administrative management and instructional leadership.

questions.subject: Management
questions.question_english: Which of the following exemplifies a 'Dysfunctional Conflict' in a school?
options_english: Teachers constructively debating the merits of two different reading instruction programs during a meeting
Personal animosity between two teachers leading to the sabotage of a joint school exhibition
An academic department passionately discussing how to restructure the syllabus for better instructional flow
The SMC formally challenging the Principal to fully justify administrative expenditure on a new project
questions.explanation_english: Dysfunctional conflict is destructive friction that hinders organizational performance, breaks communication, and undermines institutional goals. Personal animosity leading teachers to sabotage a joint school exhibition exemplifies dysfunctional conflict, as interpersonal hostility distracts from educational objectives, damages climate, and harms overall student learning and institutional harmony.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। व्यक्तिगत शत्रुता जो शिक्षकों को एक संयुक्त स्कूल प्रदर्शनी को बर्बाद करने की ओर ले जाती है, यह एक कार्यात्मक संघर्ष का उदाहरण है। यह संघर्ष संगठनात्मक प्रदर्शन को बाधित करता है और शैक्षणिक लक्ष्यों को नुकसान पहुंचाता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Personal animosity between two teachers

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Dysfunctional conflict is destructive friction that hinders organizational performance, breaks communication, and undermines institutional goals.

questions.question_hindi: नैदानिक पर्यवेक्षण में पूर्व-पर्यवेक्षण सम्मेलन का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या है:

शिक्षक को मिलने वाले अंतिम प्रदर्शन ग्रेड, संख्यात्मक रेटिंग, या मूल्यांकन स्कोर पर पहले से निर्णय लेना

questions.subject: Management
questions.question_english: The main objective of the pre-observation conference in clinical supervision is to:
options_english: Establish mutual trust and agree upon the specific focus and context of the observation
Inform the teacher about their accumulated previous instructional faults, deficiencies, and administrative warnings
Decide beforehand on the final performance grade, numeric rating, or evaluation score the teacher will receive
Provide an opportunity for the teacher to justify in advance why they might perform poorly during the lesson
questions.explanation_english: The pre-observation conference establishes a collaborative, trusting relationship between the supervisor and the educator prior to classroom observation. This meeting allows both parties to discuss lesson plans, clarify instructional objectives, identify potential challenges, and agree upon specific target areas for data collection, ensuring that the observation process remains transparent and focused.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। पूर्व-पर्यवेक्षण सम्मेलन पर्यवेक्षक और शिक्षक के बीच एक सहयोगात्मक, विश्वसनीय संबंध स्थापित करता है। यह बैठक दोनों पक्षों को पाठ योजनाओं पर चर्चा करने, शैक्षणिक उद्देश्यों को स्पष्ट करने, संभावित चुनौतियों की पहचान करने और डेटा संग्रह के लिए विशिष्ट लक्षित क्षेत्रों पर सहमत होने की अनुमति देती है, यह सुनिश्चित करते हुए कि अवलोकन प्रक्रिया पारदर्शी और केंद्रित बनी रहे।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Establish mutual trust and agree upon the specific focus and context of the observation

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The pre-observation conference establishes a collaborative, trusting relationship between the supervisor and the educator prior to classroom observation.

questions.question_hindi: एक पोस्ट-ऑब्जर्वेशन सम्मेलन के दौरान, पर्यवेक्षक शिक्षक से पूछता है, “आपको कैसे लगता है कि पाठ कैसे गया, और अगली बार आप क्या अलग करेंगे?” यह एक उदाहरण है:
options_hindi: एक अत्यधिक निर्देशात्मक, मूल्यांकनकर्ता-प्रेरित पर्यवेक्षण दृष्टिकोण
एक चिंतनशील, गैर-निर्देशात्मक पर्यवेक्षण दृष्टिकोण
एक असंरचित, हाथों से दूर laissez-faire पर्यवेक्षण दृष्टिकोण
एक सख्त तानाशाही, शीर्ष-से-नीचे पर्यवेक्षण दृष्टिकोण

questions.subject: Management
questions.question_english:
When conducting a post-observation conference,
     the supervisor asks the teacher, 'How do you feel the lesson went, and what would you do differently next time?' This is an example of:
options_english: A highly directive, evaluator-driven supervisory approach
A reflective, non-directive supervisory approach
An unstructured, hands-off laissez-faire supervisory approach
A strictly autocratic, top-down supervisory approach
questions.explanation_english: Asking open-ended, reflective questions during a post-observation conference exemplifies a non-directive, reflective supervisory approach. By inviting the educator to evaluate their own lesson execution and identify potential improvements, the supervisor encourages critical self-analysis, fosters professional autonomy, and facilitates constructive dialogic learning rather than imposing autocratic administrative evaluations.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। पोस्ट-ऑब्जर्वेशन सम्मेलन के दौरान खुले-समाप्त, चिंतनशील प्रश्न पूछना एक गैर-निर्देशात्मक, चिंतनशील पर्यवेक्षण दृष्टिकोण का उदाहरण है। शिक्षक को अपने पाठ के निष्पादन का मूल्यांकन करने और संभावित सुधारों की पहचान करने के लिए आमंत्रित करके, पर्यवेक्षक महत्वपूर्ण आत्म-विश्लेषण को प्रोत्साहित करता है, पेशेवर स्वायत्तता को बढ़ावा देता है, और निर्माणात्मक संवादात्मक सीखने की सुविधा प्रदान करता है, बजाय कि तानाशाही प्रशासनिक मूल्यांकन को लागू करने के।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) A reflective, non-directive supervisory approach

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Asking open-ended, reflective questions during a post-observation conference exemplifies a non-directive, reflective supervisory approach.
